nota.metricas: RSSI MAE (channel 3) per population (valid = target[:,0] < 299; sentinel; all) and PL MAE (channel 0) on valid nodes, from the physical predictions in the .npz; never from a log
nota.2.2_deriva_com_modelo: per cell and model: SD of MAE_validos across the 5 split seeds; compare with the SD of the means across the 4 cells (same rule as 2.1); also report the SD of the analytical baselines on the SAME split draws, read from baselines_analiticos.test of the run JSON
nota.3.3_inversao_por_sorteio: fraction of (cell × split draw) in which MAE_validos(model) < MAE of the baselines (fspl, hata_rural, cost231_sub from baselines_analiticos.test, same split draw), per model; no aggregate magnitude across cells
nota.paridade_sob_sorteio: GNN−MLP contrast paired by split seed within the cell: median, min, max, no. of split draws with GNN better out of 5, in the 3 populations; tolerance = SD across split draws of the MLP MAE_sent in the cell (rule of A3_analise)
nota.sensibilidade_larguras: per cell (Bauru Q1, Lins Q1): distribution across 5 seeds of (MAE_pop old − MAE_pop new), paired by training seed with the mlp_v3_a3_* runs; negligible effect if |median| ≤ SD across seeds of the new widths in the same cell and population; otherwise reported with sign
nota.gradscaler_e_canal_1: same rules as criterio_A3_analise (post-warm-up jumps ≤ 1 %, minimum scale ≥ 1; R-c1..R-c3 only flag)
nota.proveniencia: all runs with insumos.sha256_rf_data = manifest v4 (tensores_cftudo); in the same cell and split seed, identical test-partition hash GNN×MLP; a run with rc=3 is a finding, not data
nota.nao_determinismo: no individual run is citable; only distributions; checkpoint selection is part of the variance
nota.votos: 3 independent recalculations per number; aggregation script (v3_A4_agregar.py, to be written BEFORE reading any A4 prediction) re-run independently and read in full
nota.proibido: fix tolerances a priori in dB; read predictions before the batch closes; compare with numbers from the IEEE Access article
